module_summary: 8x1 memory built from an 8-bit shift register written by serial shift-in and read randomly through an ABC-addressed 8:1 multiplexer.

anchors.name: q
anchors.why: 8-bit shift register holding the memory contents, shifted in from S.

anchors.name: Z
anchors.why: Read data output selecting one bit of q by address ABC.

anchors.name: S
anchors.why: Serial write data shifted into q[0].

anchors.name: enable
anchors.why: Synchronous shift enable for register q.

anchors.name: A
anchors.why: Read address bit (with B, C) selecting the q bit driven onto Z.

groups.name: shift_register_memory
groups.description: 8-bit shift register written serially from S when enable is high.

groups.name: read_mux
groups.description: 8:1 mux reading q at address {A,B,C} onto Z.
